title: Vibro-Acoustic Design in Mechanical Systems
description: Application of basic acoustics and vibrations to engineering problems in vibro-acoustic design. The objective is to acquaint the student with the tools used in industry for noise and vibration control and to make the student aware of the major applications of such tools in the automotive, aerospace, and consumer product industries.
prerequisites: AER 345, AER 310. This course is open only to graduate students or undergraduates with engineering standing
